name: Metaclazepam
summary: A benzodiazepine derivative, reports indicate anxiolytic effects while lacking hypnotic effects associated with common benzodiazepines. It has an active metabolite N-desmethylmetaclazepam which is the main metabolite of metaclazepam. The drug is indicated as slightly more effective as an anxiolytic than bromazepam.

pharmacology.text: It has an active metabolite N-desmethylmetaclazepam, which is the main metabolite of metaclazepam.

uses.text: Metaclazepam (marketed under the brand name Talis) is a drug which is a benzodiazepine derivative.

sideEffects.en: It is described as causing less sleepiness than many benzodiazepines, but it can still cause drowsiness, muscle relaxation, poor coordination, memory loss and confusion. Like other benzodiazepines, regular use can lead to dependence, and stopping suddenly after regular use can cause dangerous withdrawal, including seizures. Too much can dangerously slow breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 據描述它比許多苯二氮平類較不易使人想睡，但仍可能引起嗜睡、肌肉放鬆、協調變差、失憶與混亂。和其他苯二氮平類一樣，經常使用可能導致依賴，長期使用後突然停用可能出現危險的戒斷，包括癲癇發作。過量可能使呼吸危險地減慢。
sideEffects.zhHans: 据描述它比许多苯二氮平类较不易使人想睡，但仍可能引起嗜睡、肌肉放松、协调制差、失忆与混乱。和其他苯二氮平类一样，经常使用可能导致依赖，长期使用后突然停用可能出现危险的戒断，包括癫痫发作。过量可能使呼吸危险地减慢。

fact.en: Unusually for a benzodiazepine, metaclazepam carries a methoxymethyl group where most of its relatives have a carbonyl oxygen.
fact.zh: 以苯二氮平類來說很少見，metaclazepam 在多數同類帶羰基氧的位置上接的是甲氧甲基。
fact.zhHans: 以苯二氮平类来说很少见，metaclazepam 在多数同类带羰基氧的位置上接的是甲氧甲基。
